# 74S64 - 4-2-3-2-input AND-OR-invert gates

Package DIP-14 · family 74S · catalogue file [catalog/chips/74S64.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/74S64.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 15 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![74S64 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/74S64.png) | ![74S64 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/block-74S64.png) | ![74S64 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/block-74S64.png) |

A rectangle for the whole function (or one section of it). Pin numbers are written on the lines where they meet the box; signal names are written beside them.

How to tell it on a drawing: Read the part type from the parts list and compare the pin numbers against this cut-out.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 8 | Y = NOT ((A AND B AND C AND D) OR (E AND F) OR (G AND H AND I) OR (J AND K)) | Y is low when ABCD, or EF, or GHI, or JK are all high. |

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 20 |
| outputHighMaxCurrentMa | -1.0 |
| inputSchmitt | no |
| notes | Schottky. The 74S65 is the same gate with an open-collector output. |

## Propagation delays

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns | Conditions |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| any | Y | PLH | 3.5 | 5.5 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 280 ohm |
| any | Y | PHL | 3.5 | 5.5 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 280 ohm |
| any | Y | PLH | 5 |  | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 50 pF, RL 280 ohm |
| any | Y | PHL | 5.5 |  | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 50 pF, RL 280 ohm |

## Notes

The datasheet gives no minimum propagation delays; the path-delay function uses 0 ns for the minimum.
